versions.content: Data content of legislated freeze frames If a DTC assigned to the primary fault memory is configured and refers to a DemFreezeFrameRecord- Number with 0x00 and 0xF0, the Dem shall sample the legislated freeze frame based on the data configured via DemUDSOBDFreezeFrameClassRef .
